en: A vintage black‑and‑white view of a mountain spa town set in dense forests with a small lake and buildings around it. Caption at front bottom reads "TUȘNAD – Vedere generală." The reverse is a Romanian postcard from the People's Republic era with an airmail stamp showing an airplane, a circular postmark from Tușnad dated 17 IUL 62, and handwritten greetings and address.
